digest.component_or_area: reconciler process exit codes and bridge surface
propositions: Canonical bridge commands preview and sync must emit only exit codes 0 (benign), 1 (operational failure), or 2 (invalid invocation/configuration), mapping all converged, paused, in-flight, reschedule, and legacy-gated outcomes to 0 with stable one-line state explanation.

Legacy reconcile --mode and direct engine --mode routes must retain historical exit codes 3/4/75 with their original translations and messages to preserve compatibility for systemd, Jenkins, scripts, and older workflow revisions during rolling deployment.
Canonical and legacy adapters must consume one shared typed core disposition, execute a pass exactly once, and produce identical repository/ref effects without double-runs or state mutation.

Production workflow reconcile-bridge.yml must use canonical bridge surface with only 0/1/2 handling while preserving exact paused commit-skip behavior, and legacy workflow/command fixture must remain green for all historical benign codes.

In-tree consumers of exit codes 3, 4, or 75 across deployment units, GitHub workflows, Jenkins configs, and scripts must be searched and either migrated to canonical 0/1/2 or explicitly classified as legacy compatibility consumers.
